name: blind-spot-audit-of-benchmark-verdicts
purpose: Re-adjudicate a stratified sample of the platform's own benchmark verdicts. Gold is recorded blind to the platform verdict. Disagreement is an error. A stratum whose sampled error rate exceeds the pre-registered threshold expands to a census of that class.

gold_rule.deterministic: gold equals the output of the named exact oracle; the platform must match it. A judged score used in place of an available oracle is itself an error under TST-0309, recorded separately from verdict disagreement.
gold_rule.judged: gold equals the human application of the published rubric, recorded before the platform verdict is revealed.

error: a non-blocked row whose platform_verdict disagrees with human_gold
blocked: excluded from the error-rate denominator so a BLOCKED row cannot silently improve or inflate the rate
escalation: when a stratum's sampled error rate is strictly greater than the pre-registered threshold, enqueue every case_id in that stratum's population (the whole class), not merely the sampled ids
why_stratify: a platform that is accurate on passes and wrong on failures has a specific, fixable bias that an unstratified sample averages away
